com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AgentGraphDefinition

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AgentGraphDefinition

  • public final class AgentGraphDefinition
extends java.lang.Object
    The fully resolved definition of an agent graph, containing all nodes and their edges.

    An AgentGraphDefinition is obtained from LDAIClient.agentGraph(java.lang.String, com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>). When isEnabled() returns false, the graph definition was not fetchable or failed validation; in that case all node collections are empty and traversal methods are no-ops. Only getConfig() and createTracker() remain meaningful, so callers can still inspect the raw flag value and fire graph-level usage events for a disabled graph.

    Traversal (traverse(java.util.function.BiFunction<com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AgentGraphNode, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>, java.lang.Object>, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>), reverseTraverse(java.util.function.BiFunction<com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AgentGraphNode, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>, java.lang.Object>, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>)) visits each reachable node once in topological order (predecessors-first or descendants-first), deterministically and cycle-safe. Each visitor sees only the initial context plus that node's dependency results.

    This class is thread-safe. All returned collections are unmodifiable.

      • createTracker

        public AIGraphTracker createTracker()
        Creates a new AIGraphTracker for this graph invocation.

        Each call produces a fresh tracker with a new run ID. A tracker is returned even when the graph is disabled, so callers can still fire graph-level usage events (e.g. invocation failure) when the graph's configuration could not be resolved.

        Returns:
        a new tracker, or null if no tracker factory was provided

      • traverse

        public void traverse(java.util.function.BiFunction<AgentGraphNode,java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.lang.Object>,java.lang.Object> fn,
                     java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.lang.Object> ctx)
        Topological traversal from the root (predecessors-first; root first).

        A node runs only after all reachable predecessors. Ties break by discovery order (BFS from root, declared edge order). Cycle-safe: each reachable node is visited once.

        fn receives a fresh map of the initial ctx plus that node's predecessor results only. ctx itself is not mutated. No-op if disabled or root is absent.

        Parameters:
        fn - visitor; node and dependency-scoped context
        ctx - initial context template (global scratch); not written with node results

      • reverseTraverse

        public void reverseTraverse(java.util.function.BiFunction<AgentGraphNode,java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.lang.Object>,java.lang.Object> fn,
                            java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.lang.Object> ctx)
        Reverse topological traversal (descendants-first; root last).

        A node runs only after all reachable descendants. Ties break by discovery order. Cycle-safe, including graphs with no terminals. Each reachable node is visited once.

        fn receives a fresh map of the initial ctx plus that node's descendant results only. ctx itself is not mutated. No-op if disabled or root is absent.

        Parameters:
        fn - visitor; node and dependency-scoped context
        ctx - initial context template (global scratch); not written with node results
